# Default template for the Next.js framework adapter.
#
# Layout (added over time):
#   src/app/                    Next.js app router pages
#   src/components/             Reusable components
#   src/data/                   Generated by `grove build-data`
#   public/                     Static assets
#   next.config.mjs
#   tailwind.config.mjs
#
# The CLI copies this directory verbatim into a new project
# via `grove new --framework nextjs`. Pages and layouts live
# here; business logic lives in @grove-dev/core and
# @grove-dev/ui, and is imported into the template.
